# Results

This directory holds aggregated results from SLURM jobs. Run outputs (checkpoints, logs) go to `runs/`.

## Generated by SLURM Jobs

| SLURM Script | Output Files |
|--------------|--------------|
| `slice_selection.sbatch` | `z_results.csv` — z vs val_acc, test_acc |
| `compare_thin_methods.sbatch` | `thin_method_results.csv`, `.md`, `.tex`, `thin_method_comparison.png`, `.pdf` |
| `teacher_student.sbatch` | `teacher_student_results.csv` |
| `eval_early_exit_tau.sbatch` | `early_exit_tau_results.csv` |
| `compare_ablation.sbatch` | `ablation_results.csv`, `.md`, `.tex`, `ablation_comparison.png`, `.pdf` |
| `compare_dtt_only.sbatch` | `dtt_only_results.csv` — DTT(L2/Attn/Random) only comparison |
| `eval_compute_metrics.sbatch` | `compute_metrics.csv`, `compute_metrics.md` — accuracy, ms/sample, speedup, avg exit, GFLOPs |

## Directory Layout

```
results/
├── README.md
├── z_results.csv
├── ablation_results.csv
├── ablation_results.md
├── ablation_results.tex
├── ablation_comparison.png
├── ablation_comparison.pdf
├── compute_metrics.csv
├── compute_metrics.md
├── dtt_only_results.csv
├── thin_method_results.csv
├── thin_method_results.md
├── thin_method_results.tex
├── thin_method_comparison.png
├── thin_method_comparison.pdf
├── teacher_student_results.csv
└── early_exit_tau_results.csv
```

## Run Outputs (runs/)

| Job | Output Dir |
|-----|------------|
| baseline | `runs/vit2d_baseline/` |
| slice_selection | `runs/slice_selection/z_19`, `z_48`, ... |
| compare_thin_methods | `runs/compare_thin_methods/baseline`, `l2`, `attn`, `random` |
| dtt_ee | `runs/vit2d_dtt_ee_attn/` (or l2, random) |
| teacher_student | `runs/teacher/`, `runs/student_distill/` |
| compare_ablation | `runs/compare_ablation/baseline`, `only_ee`, `dtt_only`, `dtt_ee` |
| compare_dtt_only | `runs/compare_dtt_only/l2`, `attn`, `random` |
